integrity: Proof is self-contained apart from elementary coarea/covariogram geometry. Numerical checks validate selected polyhedra and angles only. Known cube formulas are credited; historical priority and external expert validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to fixed compact nondegenerate convex polyhedra in R^3 and sufficiently small ambient Euclidean distances. C4(P) is not explicitly evaluated; general all-radius distributions, nonconvex/self-intersecting surfaces and uniform shape-family thresholds are not established.
title: The exact short Euclidean surface-pair law and its dihedral bending coefficient
